claims.claim: B is angry with some children
claims.mechanism: imperative presupposition: 'Don't be X' presupposes addressee is currently X; 'them' coreferential with 'children' in next sentence

evidence.quote: Don ’ t be angry with them . After all , they are still children .

claims.repair_of: B was angry with some children
claims.verifier_basis: Imperative 'Don't be angry with them' presupposes B is currently angry; 'they are still children' resolves 'them' to children.

claims.claim: B attributes crime to the children's actions
claims.mechanism: counterfactual conditional presupposes the addressee currently holds the position being advised against

evidence.quote: If I were you , I would not put crime in their doing these thing

claims.repair_of: B attributed criminality to the children’s actions
claims.verifier_basis: Counterfactual conditional 'If I were you, I would not X' presupposes that B does X, i.e., B attributes crime to the children's actions.
